lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular clusters are arranged in horizontal rows across the mid-to-posterior flank. Posterior to the pectoral fin, the blobs increase in diameter and spacing, forming a sparse grid with inter-blob distances roughly twice the blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like structure of anchor nodes most prominent in the upper-mid lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge to deep shadows on the ventral-facing edge.
